integ.biDesc2: Paging with $top (max 5000) / $skip, incremental refresh with modifiedSince. People are pseudonymous unless the token includes names. Descriptions, chat and notes are never exported.
integ.outboxNote: — failed deliveries retry with exponential backoff (6 attempts); 4xx errors stop immediately.

cfg.changesAreRecordedInTheAudit: Changes are recorded in the audit log.
cfg.internalTeamsAcceptUsersFromInternal: Internal teams accept users from internal tenants.
cfg.vendorOutsourceTeamsOnlyAcceptUsers: Vendor/outsource teams only accept users from the team's own Microsoft tenant.
cfg.allTicketsWithoutAMoreSpecific: All tickets without a more specific profile (default)
cfg.notAssignedToAnyCategoryOr: Not assigned to any category or team yet.
cfg.requireApprovalBeforeItStartsWork: Require approval before IT starts work on certain request types. The SLA is paused while approval is pending.
cfg.name: Name
cfg.externalVendorAndOutsourceSupportTeams: External vendor and outsource support teams, their members and access expiry.
cfg.externalUsersSignInWithTheir: External users sign in with their own Microsoft tenant, only see tickets owned by/assigned to their team, never see internal notes, and lose access automatically at their expiry date. Deactivate a user under User Management to cut access immediately.
cfg.configureWhetherThisStatusChangeIs: Configure whether this status change is allowed and by whom.
cfg.limitedToYourTeamsAndTickets: limited to your teams and tickets
cfg.noRowsForTheSelectedFilters: No rows for the selected filters.
cfg.moreRowsAvailableExportToCsv: More rows available — export to CSV for the full report.
cfg.usersWhoBelongToAtLeast: Users who belong to at least one support team. Manage membership from Support Teams.
cfg.workingWindowsPerWeekdayAndTimezone: Working windows per weekday and timezone. SLA clocks only run inside these windows (except 24×7 targets); holidays are excluded.
cfg.controlledStatusTransitionsRulesEnforced: Controlled status transitions. Rules enforced server-side on every change.
cfg.useTheMenuToManageConfiguration: Use the menu to manage configuration.
cfg.businessDayNote: 1 business day = {h} working hours of this profile's calendar. Changes apply to new tickets and to tickets whose priority/category changes; open tickets keep their snapshot.
cfg.matrixLegend: ✓ = allowed for support staff holding the required permission · R = requester may also perform it (e.g. cancel, confirm closure, reopen within the reopen window). Click a cell to edit.
cfg.reportsNote: Preview shows the first {n} rows. Exports contain up to 50,000 rows, are limited to your data scope, never include chat messages or internal notes, and are recorded in the audit log.
cfg.workflowRules: Built-in rules regardless of this matrix: WAITING statuses require a reason · RESOLVED requires a resolution summary and all required tasks completed · CLOSED/CANCELLED tickets are read-only unless the user holds ticket.closed.edit · requesters can reopen only within the configured reopen window.
cfg.slaIntro: Response and resolution clocks run in business time of the profile's calendar (or 24×7 per priority), pause in the configured statuses, and are checked every minute by the SLA job: warnings at the profile threshold, breaches at 100%, plus escalation rules.

crud.departmentsBelongToACompanyEmployees: Departments belong to a company. Employees of one department may work at any branch/location.
crud.emptyUseEachStatusSOwn: Empty = use each status's own 'Pauses SLA' flag

crud.holidaysAreExcludedFromBusinessHours: Holidays are excluded from business-hours SLA calculations.
crud.internalVendorAndOutsourceTeamsManage: Internal, vendor and outsource teams. Manage members from the team's Members page.
crud.kindDrivesSystemBehaviourEG: Kind drives system behaviour (e.g. WAITING requires a reason, RESOLVED requires a resolution). Transitions are managed under Workflow.
crud.leaveParentEmptyForAMain: Leave Parent empty for a main category. Defaults drive automatic routing, priority and SLA.
crud.level1IsTheMostUrgent: Level 1 is the most urgent. SLA targets per priority are configured in SLA profiles.
crud.mustBeAMemberOfThe: Must be a member of the team
crud.name: Name
crud.onlyUsersFromActiveTenantsListed: Only users from active tenants listed here can sign in. Identity is (Tenant ID, Object ID) — email domains are never used for authorization.
crud.otherwiseNewUsersAreCreatedAs: Otherwise new users are created as Pending for approval
crud.pauseTheSlaClockWhileThe: Pause the SLA clock while the ticket is in
crud.profilesAreChosenPerSubcategoryCategory: Profiles are chosen per subcategory → category → support team → default. Targets per priority are edited on each profile's Targets page.
crud.rulesAreEvaluatedInAscendingOrder: Rules are evaluated in ascending order before category defaults. Empty conditions match anything.
crud.thaiDisplayNameLeaveEmptyTo: Thai display name. Leave empty to show the English name.
